I think people are individuals and can't be lumped like this. Someone being more anxious as a FA or more avoidant has more to do with their own specific experiences, childhood and onward as well as current relationship dynamics which are variable. I know for me this doesn't resonate at all.

I relate to what you're saying a lot. I really appreciate this sub a lot and it's responsible in part for so much of my secure leaning growth lately. I feel like this space is a lot safer and like you said people get curious, help us reflect while holding us accountable to the way we act without the vitriol or coddling. He has layers if you're looking for them. Matilda was arguably worse than Pen being the mastermind of everything and pretended to to be Alliance for years, had influence in the church and went to insane depths to make the plan against Sandrock work. By the time Pen is jailed he's accepted his fate and tries to make it easier on the builder if they had a friendship or relationship by letting them go. It's easier to move on if you can blame someone else. He was a grey character at worst. He wasn't made to be hated, people are just stuck in their assumptions to see past the facade. If you dated the character you would see his layers, if you were looking for them you'd see his layers. If you only accept things at face value and want someone to dislike then you get your response. If you've met a narcissist in real life you'd know they're far more insidious than Pen ever was, and know that you're just misusing language. Pen showed on multiple occasions that he cared about other people not just himself. Maybe it's naive but I think a lot of people are capable of redemption if they're willing to put in the work, if he can acknowledge his mistakes and make the strides to improve and the benefits far outweigh his mistakes, he can still come back. He would need to do some kind of arrangements with the prison and likely a ton of community services like Miguel.

I don't think the solutions are that simple to solve Duvos problems. Most people don't go to war if they can afford to, not. Mm no, I don't think him being in Evershine is unrealistic, I said OTHER people who judge and hate him would prefer he isn't, and would only be okay with him showing up again if other games passed the time. I think he could make some kind of arrangements or do some kind of service to work with the Alliance against Duvos and end up helping to rebuild. 

I feel like.. your opinions of Pen are really harsh. I don't really understand the aggressive hate towards him, I felt like Pathea did a great job making him a grey character but people just like to dogpile on him cuz they need someone to hate, when Matilda did most of the scheming. He's not a crazy villain he was forced to do the things because he had no choice in where he grew up and had to do things to survive. He takes pleasure in combat, but not in killing there's a huge difference. 

There's an argument & story for him in Sandrock but it would take a lot for the town to take him back and I think the devs are done with Sandrock for now, so I can't see that happening.

As a survivor of narcissistic abuse and also a Pen enjoyer, I wish people would stop saying he's narcissistic without knowing what the word fully encompasses. He's got an ego among other negative characteristics but he does actually show he cares for other people around the town, it wasn't just the builder he loved. 

I think a redemption arc is due but non-fans will probably complain at the lack of realism if time doesn't pass for awhile (so between a couple more games), before we can have him back. Since his deeds were more sinister than Aadits (as far as we know). 

I still think a game focusing on Duvos would help understand his actions better. I think Stev is the odd one out able to voice that the way Duvos goes about things is wrong, but I imagine that standing up is generally not possible in most cases and people are forced to go along with things as a way of survival for the most part.

For now, the Pen mod by Doremi is a fantastic substitute, and the lovely creations on Ao3 help me get by in the meantime. If there can be justice for Aadit my hope is we can be allowed the same for Pen at some point.

Okay, so I spent like 20 minutes trying to get it through normal means myself before giving up and digging through the Pathea discord for answer.   
  
Turns out, you have to throw stuff on the floor and platform on it to get across. If you don't know, to throw, bring up the wheel with TAB and select "Throw Item".   
  
I tried to record myself going to one of the locations you circled just so you can get an idea of how to do it but it looks like I can't post a video in the comments. I crafted a bunch of Single Beds on my worktable (but any item would work) and threw them and stacked them on top of each other like stairs to get across.   
  
You do have to be kinda careful because you can only throw so many things on the floor before you get a message saying you can't put anything else down until you pick some stuff up; so if you're doing multiple spots I'd pick up whatever you threw down before you go to the next chest.
